answer.new_information: NN, Inc. announced in late June 2026 that 47 new machine centers would be added to its Wuxi, China plant for liquid cooling production for NVIDIA AI data center racks, with 100% of the new capacity said to be pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards and a 2026 target of US$80–US$90 million of accretive new business. The record also reports NN's removal from the Russell Microcap Value Index in late June 2026. The NN revenue and earnings projections to 2028 are third-party narrative and unnamed analyst estimates, not company guidance. The subject is NN, Inc., a supplier, while research scope covers NVDA only, and no stored or catalog questions exist to update.
